TS040 division-intent

Integer division names the way it rounds, because the remainder is discarded either way.

languages: rust zig
severity: info
default: opt-in
group: stable
go: integer division is spelled with the same operator as float division; telling them apart needs type inference this linter does not do
javascript: integer division is spelled with the same operator as float division; telling them apart needs type inference this linter does not do
odin: integer division is spelled with the same operator as float division; telling them apart needs type inference this linter does not do
python: the // operator already names the rounding, and telling / apart needs type inference this linter does not do
typescript: integer division is spelled with the same operator as float division; telling them apart needs type inference this linter does not do

TigerStyle: "Show your intent with respect to division. For example, use `@divExact()`, `@divFloor()` or `div_ceil()` to show the reader you've thought through all the interesting scenarios where rounding may be involved."
